stories.title: Global Talent visa expanded to attract world's brightest researchers to power British innovation
stories.summary: The Home Office announced an expansion of the Global Talent visa on 6 August, aimed at giving more than 100 of the UK's most innovative companies easier access to top international research talent.

stories.title: Reform UK pledges to jail bosses employing illegal workers
stories.summary: Reform UK proposed imprisoning company bosses who employ illegal migrants and fining larger firms 10% of global revenue; the Home Office says it is already increasing penalties for non-compliant employers.

stories.title: More than 1,100 people convicted of illegal arrival in UK since 2022
stories.summary: New figures show over 1,100 convictions for illegal arrival via small boat crossings since 2022, as the government continues its crackdown on Channel crossings.

stories.title: 'Alarming' surge in bluetongue disease among UK sheep
stories.summary: Farmers and vets have raised alarm over a sharp rise in bluetongue virus cases among UK sheep flocks, prompting concern about animal welfare and livestock trade impacts.

stories.title: NHS must prepare for annual summer heat pressures, says Yvette Cooper
stories.summary: The Home Secretary said the NHS needs to plan annually for the health impacts of rising summer temperatures, as data shows more frequent 30C+ days in Greater London.

stories.title: Why we're engaging with the AI Airlock
stories.summary: The Health Research Authority explains its involvement in the 'AI Airlock', a space for regulators and developers to work through key questions on deploying AI safely in healthcare.
